subject: Invoice cadence & PO setup — aligning settlement lane for Novara Health
messages:
From: Emma Lewis <emma@novarahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Novara Procurement <procurement@novarahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay options

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Novara is ready to complete vendor setup so we can get your team live next month. Two items we want to lock down before we submit the onboarding packet:

1) Invoice cadence: our AP team prefers Net45 for cross-border vendors. Can Redwood accept Net45 here, or do you require Net30/Net60?
2) Early-pay program: Novara can offer early-pay (1% if paid at Net30 rather than Net45). If Redwood has an early-pay election process, please confirm steps and any forms we need to sign.

Attached is our standard onboarding form (Novara_Onboarding_Form.pdf) and a bank details stub — I can provide a formal PO number once Redwood confirms the billing lane. We also need the W9 on file.

Goal: have vendor profile and PO established by 05/10 so first invoice can be processed mid-May.

Thanks,
Emma Lewis
Director, Strategic Ops
Novara Health
Attachments: Novara_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), Novara_Bank_Stub.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lewis <emma@novarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay options

Hi Emma — thanks for the form and the clear timeline.

Quick answers up front:
- We can support Net45 and Net60, but Net45 requests go through Finance approval (standard turnaround 24–48 hours) — Net30 is our default.
- We have an early-pay enrollment option. Typical terms we offer: 0.5% discount for Net30 if vendor enrolls in automated early-pay, or 1.5% for Net15. I’ll loop Finance to confirm whether we can match the 1% you suggested.

Next steps I’ll kick off:
1) Laura, can you confirm whether Net45 for Novara requires escalation or if we can approve directly? Also please attach our W9 for Emma’s records.
2) Marissa, I’ll need a short MAP (mutual action plan) to align dates and the PO handoff.
3) Emma — if you can provide the preferred invoice email and whether Novara requires invoice PDF + CSV, that helps speed routing.

I’ve attached a short onboarding checklist link (internal) and I’ll drop the DocuSign for standard vendor T&Cs once Finance confirms the lane.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (internal link stub)
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay options

On Wed, Apr 28, 2027 at 4:05 PM Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’ll loop Finance to confirm whether we can match the 1% you suggested.

Jordan/Marissa — putting the finance rules here for clarity so we have an auditable trail:

- Default policy: NET30 (no approval required).
- NET45/NET60: acceptable but require finance approval for change in payment lane. For external partners where cash conversion is requested (Net45 -> Net30 with early-pay), we evaluate on a per-supplier basis.
- Early-pay program: enrollment required via our Vendor Early-Pay form. Current published options:
  * Net15 payout — up to 1.5% discount (higher discount tiers reviewed case-by-case)
  * Net30 with early-pay enrollment — 0.5% discount (automated schedule)

For Novara specifically: if they provide PO now and are willing to enroll in our Net30 early-pay, we can approve 0.5% off invoices paid early. Matching their requested 1% needs CFO sign-off — please flag if this is a material economic concession for the deal.

Required artifacts to complete vendor setup and PO routing:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we received Novara_Onboarding_Form.pdf)
- W9 (Redwood_W9.pdf attached)
- Banking stub or remittance instructions (we have Novara_Bank_Stub.pdf)
- Signed vendor terms (DocuSign link will be generated after PO is confirmed)

Please ensure PO number is included on all invoices in the header (PO: RDW-XXXX) and that invoices are sent to ap-invoices@redwood.com. If Novara requires Net45 for internal reasons, we can accept it but note the payment date will be aligned to that lane and early-pay discounts will be judged against the vendor's requested term.

Laura Bennett
Dir, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf, vendor_terms_summary.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lewis <emma@novarahealth.com>, Novara Procurement <procurement@novarahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay options — mutual action plan

Emma — great to meet yesterday. Summarizing the MAP so we’re aligned on dates and owners:

1) Today (04/29) — Novara returns signed onboarding form (thanks for the PDF).
2) 04/29–04/30 — Redwood Finance validates W9 and bank details (Laura) and confirms lane (Net30 default; Net45 accepted upon approval).
3) 05/02 — Jordan to issue preliminary PO request to Novara; procurement to confirm PO format.
4) 05/05 — Novara to submit first invoice referencing the PO.
5) 05/15 — Expected first remittance date assuming Net30/Early-pay enrollment.

Open items:
- Emma: confirm preferred invoice file types (PDF only or PDF + CSV) and whether AP will send ACH remittance advices.
- Jordan: please provide the PO number once created so Novara can include it on invoices.

If you’re comfortable with the above, I’ll create a shared Drive folder and drop the DocuSign envelope for your signature.

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Emma Lewis <emma@novarahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Novara Procurement <procurement@novarahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice cadence & early-pay options — mutual action plan

Hi all — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming the following from Novara side: 

- We signed and attached the onboarding form (Novara_Signed_Onboarding.pdf).
- AP will send invoices as PDF only (one file per invoice) and will include the PO number.
- Our AP prefers Net45 internally, but Novara is willing to enroll in early-pay at 0.5% for Net30 to keep things moving. We cannot commit to the 1% you proposed, so 0.5% is our acceptance.
- PO number for initial testing: NH-2027-5782 (please confirm this maps to Redwood’s PO field).

Emma Lewis
Director, Strategic Ops — Novara Health
Attachments: Novara_Signed_Onboarding.pdf
